body: As I sit down at the community board, I notice that our usual meeting sign has been moved, and the only indication of a recent gathering is a hastily scrawled note: "Last one stood out." It dawns on me that I should check our shared messaging app to see if anyone else had sent a message about this missed meeting.
full: As I sit down at the community board, I notice that our usual meeting sign has been moved, and the only indication of a recent gathering is a hastily scrawled note: "Last one stood out." It dawns on me that I should check our shared messaging app to see if anyone else had sent a message about this missed meeting. Next: confront the person responsible directly.
